outcome.outcome: Quantum-chemical accuracy at molecular-dynamics cost. Reaction energetics get screened computationally instead of measured one system at a time.
outcome.rationale: Their description names surrogate models and AI-accelerated quantum chemistry as the underexploited route; the unlock is the accuracy-cost tradeoff collapsing.

ai_types.rationale: Machine-learned force fields and neural wavefunction methods are in production use; six of their eight capabilities are surrogate or dataset work.

measurability.rationale: Error against high-level reference calculations at a stated compute budget is the field's standard benchmark.

outcome.outcome: You can look at where the atoms actually are, instead of inferring arrangement from bulk averages, and tie a material's properties to its real structure.
outcome.rationale: Their description frames the loss as understanding properties at the most fundamental level.

ai_types.rationale: Atomic-resolution reconstruction from sparse, dose-limited signal is an inverse problem where learned reconstruction directly buys resolution.

measurability.rationale: Whether individual atoms are resolved, and at what dose and field of view, is a direct instrument specification.

outcome.outcome: Synthesis routes get planned rather than discovered. Most of chemical space has never been tested, and reaction outcomes across it turn predictable.
outcome.rationale: Their description names the missing ingredient as large synthesis and processing datasets enabling predictive models.

ai_types.rationale: The stated blocker is missing data, not missing algorithms, and closed-loop synthesis is the only route to generating it at the required scale.
Reaction prediction models already work where data exists, which is exactly why data generation is the binding link.

measurability.rationale: Held-out reaction yield and product prediction accuracy, and coverage of reaction classes, are countable.

outcome.outcome: Read the structure straight off the spectrum. Crystallisation and purification drop out of the critical path for structure determination.
outcome.rationale: Their description frames it as an inverse problem where information is lost; recovering it removes the slow experimental step.

ai_types.rationale: Structure-from-spectrum is a classic ill-posed inversion, and learned priors are the standard way such inversions become tractable.
Forward spectrum prediction from structure works now and supplies the training signal for the inverse direction.

measurability.rationale: Structure elucidation accuracy on held-out spectra with known answers is a direct, already-used benchmark.

outcome.outcome: How many compounds get tested each year stops depending on how many synthetic chemists there are.
outcome.rationale: Their description names throughput and reproducibility as the losses from manual synthesis.

ai_types.rationale: Chemputers and automated synthesis platforms are operating today; this is the domain where closed-loop labs are most mature.
General-purpose manipulation of arbitrary glassware and solids remains the limit on what automation can cover.

measurability.rationale: Compounds synthesised per instrument-day and human hours per compound are direct throughput measures.

outcome.outcome: Smell turns into a measurement. Predict perceived odour from structure and chemical sensing becomes diagnostic rather than descriptive.
outcome.rationale: Their description names flavour science, disease diagnostics and animal communication as the downstream unlocks.

ai_types.rationale: Structure-to-percept mapping is a supervised prediction problem, already partly demonstrated on olfaction benchmark datasets.
Receptor-binding maps require multiplexed assay readout at a scale current sensing does not reach.

measurability.rationale: Predicted versus panel-rated odour descriptors on held-out molecules is a direct and already-run evaluation.

outcome.outcome: The design-build-test loop that transformed DNA and protein work extends to the rest of polymer chemistry.
outcome.rationale: Their description sets up the contrast explicitly: nucleic acid synthesis advancing rapidly, everything else underdeveloped.

ai_types.rationale: The single listed capability is a solid-phase synthesiser for other polymers, which is instrument construction rather than a computational problem.
Coupling chemistry and protecting-group strategy for new monomer classes is a search problem over reaction conditions.

measurability.rationale: Achievable chain length, per-step coupling efficiency and monomer diversity are direct synthesis metrics.

notes: Taxonomy strain on the last gap: building a synthesiser is instrument engineering, which sits between 'Physical build and manipulation' and nothing else in the taxonomy. Marked as a guess. Chemistry is the field where 'Autonomous experimentation' is genuinely 'Working now', consistent with the brief's framing.
